title: The Prayer Ribbons
text: A tree is hung with thousands of prayer ribbons, one tied by every pilgrim who passed, all faded grey by sun and rain. They rustle like whispers in the wind. Some are in your House's colors, tied by Scions long dead.

options.label: Tie a ribbon for the House, beside those your ancestors left.

outcomes.text: Your prayer for the House hangs among a thousand others, whispering with them.

options.label: The wisest reads your House's old ribbons, to learn what your forebears prayed for.

outcomes.text: They hold your ancestors' prayers, and one secret they should never have tied to a tree.

options.label: Cut down a rival's ribbon, and let their prayers go unheard.

outcomes.text: It is petty and satisfying. For a moment the whispering stops.
